name: The Mighty Mine
summary:
The Mighty Mine is a horror exploration-type VR game focused on mining and exploring caves. Using Gorilla Tag like locomotion, traverse the dark cave areas, look for ores to fill your index and make sure not to get caught by whatever is lurking down there...

The Mighty Mine offers a lot of player customisation, upgradable sacks and gear, several different levels and opportunities to make new friends and have a ton of fun!
